ngaap.guidance: 2025 guidance (24-Jul-2025): Revenue ~$21.75B (prior $21.4B - $21.7B); adjusted segment operating margin mid - high 15%; Non-GAAP diluted EPS $10.40 - $10.60 (prior $10.30 - $10.50; bridge: H1 performance and guidance update ~+0.40 to $10.70 - $10.90 before tax reform, impact of tax reform ~(0.30)); adjusted free cash flow ~$2.65B (prior $2.4B - $2.5B). Segments: CS $5,600 - $5,700M, ~25%; IMS ~$6,400M (prior ~$6,300M), ~12% (prior high 11%); SAS ~$7,100M (prior $6,900 - $7,100M), low 12%; AR ~$2,800M, mid 12%. Other: FAS/CAS operating adjustment ~$15M; non-service FAS pension income ~$285M (prior ~$270M); net interest expense ~$600M; effective tax rate on non-GAAP income 13.5% - 14.5% (prior 11.0% - 12.0%; +200 to 300 bps from tax reform); weighted-average diluted shares ~188M (prior 188 - 189M); capital expenditures ~2% of revenue. 2026 outlook also increased (headline; figures not in the release tables).
ngaap.notes: From Q1-25 Non-GAAP diluted EPS no longer adds back amortization of acquisition-related intangibles (2024 comparatives recast: the amortization add-back and its tax effect removed); it = diluted EPS + merger, acquisition and divestiture-related expenses + business divestiture-related losses (gains) / impairment of goodwill and other assets + LHX NeXt implementation costs (+ accrued corporate charge in Q4-25) + "income taxes on above adjustments and other, net". Pension adjusted non-GAAP diluted EPS = non-GAAP diluted EPS less the after-tax per-share FAS/CAS operating adjustment and non-service FAS pension income. Adjusted segment operating income = operating income excluding all unallocated corporate items (incl. amortization of acquisition-related intangibles, corporate department expense, FAS/CAS operating adjustment and the significant items) and, from Q4-25, segment impairment of goodwill and other assets; i.e. the sum of segment operating income (+ segment impairments). Effective tax rate on non-GAAP income excludes the amortization add-back from 2025 (2024 comparatives recast: e.g. Q1-24 5.5% vs 13.1% originally). Free cash flow = operating cash flow - capital expenditures + proceeds from disposal of PP&E; adjusted free cash flow adds cash used for merger, acquisition and severance. Organic revenue excludes completed divestitures (antenna May-2024, AOT Jan-2025, CAS Mar-2025). Quarter free cash flow bridge recorded; year to date: 598 / (147) / 9 / 460 / 42 / 502. Tax on the adjusting items nets to an $11M reduction (66 GAAP vs 55 non-GAAP; divestiture-related tax (18)).
